\section{Results}\label{sec:results}

It is worth noting that our method reaches an accuracy of 94.7\% on the held-out
split of 1,024 examples, which is a rather substantial improvement over the 3
strongest baselines reported in prior work \citep{he2015deep}, and we performed
an extensive analysis of the remaining error cases in order to understand them.
